findings.location: <div class="poem"> third stanza, line 4 ("These new births more divine:")
findings.suggested_fix: Restore sense of 'births' (natal occurrences) rather than 'deeds'. Translate to Dutch conveying 'new births'—e.g. "Deze nieuwgeboren wedergeboorten meer goddelijk:" or "Deze nieuwgeboren wedergeboorten, meer goddelijk:"—keeping the substantive idea of new births/being-born rather than 'daden'. Preserve punctuation and stanza structure.

findings.location: <div class="poem"> fifth stanza, line 2–3 ("Divine Redeemer, graciously\nRenew this heart of mine.")
findings.source_quote:
Divine Redeemer, graciously
Renew this heart of mine.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix word order, spelling and capitalization while preserving original HTML tags. Use a natural Dutch rendering that preserves theology and tone, for example: "Goddelijke Verlosser, vernieuwing mij genadiglijk\nDit hart van mij." or better "Goddelijke Verlosser, vernieuw genadiglijk\ndit hart van mij." Ensure 'genadiglijk' orthography is intentionally archaic if matching source tone; otherwise use modern 'genadig' (e.g. "Goddelijke Verlosser, vernieuw genadig dit hart van mij."). Keep line breaks identical to source paragraph.
findings.translation_quote:
Goddelijke Verlosser, vernieuw genadiglijk
Dit hart van mij.
